fixture_purpose: pin lifecycle three-state vocabulary + retry_at field + StageTerminal + Outcome

lifecycle_states.description: Waiting for execution (incl. timed retry parked with retry_at)
Executing (retrying event carrying retry_at MUST NOT downgrade to pending; parked state is pending)
Terminal (success OR terminal failure); lifecycle projection no longer changes

retry_at_rules.validation: retry_at, when present, MUST NOT be zero; retry_at is only valid on retry_scheduled events (contract.go:495-501)

stage_terminal.description: Single terminal stage; JourneyEvent.Stage == StageTerminal marks lifecycle=completed

success.meaning: Terminal success: client received a complete response

failure.meaning: Terminal failure: retry budget exhausted OR unrecoverable upstream error

canceled.meaning: Terminal cancellation: request_canceled event MUST carry outcome=canceled

validation_rules: lifecycle_state MUST be one of: pending, in_flight, completed
retry_at, when present, MUST be on retry_scheduled event with non-zero value
Outcome MUST be one of: success, failure, canceled (empty means no terminal yet)
